parsed.name: 晶圆探针台
parsed.description: 用于半导体晶圆电学测试的探针台，可精确定位晶圆与探针，在测试仪器配合下对晶圆上器件进行接触和测量，常用于参数表征、工艺开发与失效分析。
parsed.description_en: A wafer prober used for semiconductor wafer electrical testing. It precisely positions the wafer and probe needles so instruments can contact and measure on-wafer devices, commonly for device characterization, process development, and failure analysis.

actions.description: 向晶圆探针台控制系统发送 SCI 命令字符串，以执行设备控制或查询。
actions.description_en: Send an SCI command string to the wafer prober control system to perform device control or query operations.
